Garage description
This paint is assembled from a variety of scrap materials, providing the perfect cover for the guerrilla tanker who wants to take advantage of the element of surprise.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on February 6, 2015.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Guerilla was worth 23,000 crystals and was purchasable at the rank of  Warrant Officer 2
Legacy paint description:
A paint offering good protection against Vulcan, and slight protection against Hammer and Shaft. Will be useful at mid and long ranges. Makes your tank look like a seasoned soldier.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
